MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

2. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

5. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.

8. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

9. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Media Ownership and Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Media Technology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

3. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

6. A — Information and Communication Technology

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

10. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.
